COPY IMAGE 1's contact pose: foreground NEAR thigh leads LEFT with straightened knee and heel touching ground. Background FAR leg extends BACK RIGHT with heel lifted. Near arm swings backward RIGHT, far arm forward LEFT. Match the woman's scale and proportions to other transferred poses.
